Interpolation of orientable total domination by safe arc reversals: a proof of the Hansen-Lai-Yue conjecture (JCMCC 1999; Anderson-Dravec-Johnston-Kuenzel Conjecture 3.1, arXiv:2311.16307)

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

The full conjecture for all finite graphs admitting a valid orientation: every integer between dom_t(G) and DOM_t(G) is the total domination number of a valid orientation.

AI-assisted research preprint. The scoped main statement has a Lean certificate. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review; bounded prior-art searches do not certify worldwide priority. See the paper for exact qualifications and formalization limits.
